classification_method: For original five-corner source glyph polygons, get UNIQUE source SVG M/L points, uppermost and lowermost y extremal horizontal widths. The smaller width is the tip end, even if the source glyph tip is horizontally flattened and has two points. If width_top < width_bottom, tip-up; if >, tip-down. No spin, charge or particle-state interpretation inferred by this source geometry fact.
